title: MAIW Live OpenShell Sandbox + Approved Nemotron 3/3.5 End-to-End Qualification
verdict_reason: Phase 20C-B: Real OpenShell sandbox (maiw-qual-20c-b) executed real inference through MAIW HTTP inference boundary (POST /api/v1/inference) to approved Nemotron 3/3.5 model (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, gen=nemotron-3). 51 real_sandbox tests pass on qualification host. Auth fail-closed confirmed (401 without/wrong token). All 8 forbidden-field tests pass with 422. Proof SOP A reached WAITING_FOR_GOVERNANCE. No WRITE authority paths in sandbox. Full security boundary verified end-to-end.

qualification_host.gpus: 4 x NVIDIA H100 NVL (95830 MiB each)

sandbox.name: maiw-qual-20c-b
sandbox.network_policy: deny-by-default; only MAIW inference endpoint at 10.185.115.61:8020 allowed via rest protocol
sandbox.isolation_verified: hostname differs from host, UID differs from host, Python version differs

inference_endpoint.auth: X-Maiw-Internal-Token header (fail-closed: 401 without token, 401 with wrong token)
inference_endpoint.note: MAIW_INFERENCE_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED MUST NOT be true for qualification

bug_fix.title: ModelResponse.usage schema mismatch with newer NIM API
bug_fix.symptom: HTTP 500 on first real inference: ValidationError — usage.prompt_tokens_details: Input should be a valid integer, got nested dict
bug_fix.root_cause: NIM API now returns nested sub-objects (prompt_tokens_details, completion_tokens_details) inside usage field. Schema said dict[str, int].
bug_fix.fix: Changed usage: dict[str, int] → usage: dict[str, Any] in both nim_client.py (LLMResponse/EmbeddingResponse dataclasses) and models.py (ModelResponse.usage field)
bug_fix.test_coverage: 51 real_sandbox tests confirm fix; existing 584 package tests continue to pass

hard_gate_evidence.gate: Real inference from inside sandbox through full chain: sandbox → MAIW HTTP endpoint → PolicyFilter → approved Nemotron
hard_gate_evidence.chain: OpenShell sandbox → POST http://10.185.115.61:8020/api/v1/inference → InferenceRequest validation → get_model_gateway() → PolicyFilter → ModelRouter → NIMProvider → integrate.api.nvidia.com (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b)

ssrf_denial_tests.localhost_blocked_from_sandbox: PASS (sandbox cannot reach localhost:8020, only host IP 10.185.115.61:8020)

main_suite.note: tests/contract/test_phase_20c_approved_nemotron.py (63 tests) run in isolation due to pre-existing test isolation issue with unit/mock_model_gateway fixtures; 63 pass in isolation
